insights.one_liner: Part of German insurer Allianz; the open Rotterdam role is a machine learning job at digital insurer Allianz Direct, and Allianz's Dutch entities are recognised visa sponsors.

culture.text: Allianz Direct calls itself Europe's leading digital insurer and is building a fully data-driven organisation around technology, automation and customer experience.
The Dutch group, Allianz Nederland Groep N.V., is owned by Allianz SE in Germany.

open.text: Allianz Benelux, Allianz Nederland Groep and the Dutch branch of Allianz Direct are all IND recognised sponsors.
Its one open job here, a mid-level ML engineering role in Rotterdam, does not require Dutch.
